data.long_meaning: The meaning of Sonni is recorded in name-lists as “Resemblance to Son”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sonni total 26, reducing to 8. Number 8 is associated with ambition, authority and material mastery.

in_hebrew.name: Sonni
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Resemblance to Son
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Sonni הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek name 'Sonnia', which means 'resembling a son'. This name was traditionally given to a girl who was expected to bear a son in the future.

in_greek.name: Sonni
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Resemblance to Son
in_greek.long_meaning: Sonni είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Greek name 'Sonnia', which means 'resembling a son'. This name was traditionally given to a girl who was expected to bear a son in the future.

in_latin.name: Sonni
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Resemblance to Son
in_latin.long_meaning: Sonni est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Greek name 'Sonnia', which means 'resembling a son'. This name was traditionally given to a girl who was expected to bear a son in the future.
